body: First of all we need to fix black screen of death, and add debounce for modifying the url. When user scrolls through slider, we should only update url once user stops touching the slider and so, but even here we need debounce if touching itself ends to often. Leaving and entering angle for fixed angles not always work, something is broken. The same for curvature and other settings, when links reference itself. Bend of single reference also does not affect links that reference itself (i'm not sure if it should), but if we have only links that reference itself it changes nothing and adds confusion to the UX. Gap before middle should be configurable from both sides (for start and end of each link). Also offset of bar and other elements from the end of the link must be configurable, the same can go for both start and end of the link for any artistic flexibility. For example if we offset the bar a bit from the start of the link, it looks like cross, which feels better. Arrow and other shapes also may be offset for some other artistic visions, so everything should be much more configurable. Double check all the configurations which also may be useful to be configurable are added, all symmetrical and so on, meaning if we can do something in one place, we should be able to do it in all places. And double check all these cases are fully covered with tests and are 100% reliable, so everything working perfectly, and we don't show a setting or disable it, when it will not take any effect, but we also need to carefully think when it should and shouldn't work. As angles are clearly should be working even if link references itself for example. Also if we put ring in the middle, we should also be able to cut though the link in the same middle, so it looks like line goes to the ring splits and then merges on the other side of ring. Just another configuration, not a default. ``` https://konard.github.io/network/?code=1221&angles=fixed&targetAngle=47&tension=0.33&bulge=45&gap=0.08&rotation=223&startSize=2.5&startAngle=70&endSize=3.5&endAngle=45&middle=dot&middleSize=2&strokeWidth=1.3&linejoin=miter&palette=custom&bgColor=%23000000&card=false&width=2048&height=2048&colors=%23ff2600%2C%2300f900%2C%23f472b6%2C%23facc15%2C%2334d399%2C%23fb923c%2C%2360a5fa%2C%23f87171%2C%23a3e635 ``` ``` https://konard.github.io/network/?code=00023044&angles=fixed&targetAngle=47&tension=0.33&bulge=45&gap=0.08&startSize=2.5&startAngle=70&endSize=3.5&endAngle=45&middle=dot&middleSize=2&strokeWidth=1.3&linejoin=miter&palette=custom&bgColor=%23000000&card=false&width=2048&height=2048&colors=%23ff2600%2C%2300f900%2C%23fffb00%2C%230433ff%2C%2334d399%2C%23fb923c%2C%2360a5fa%2C%23f87171%2C%23a3e635 ``` Also defaults should be set to similar to these, as they look nice (rotation should not be changed by default). We also need to have different schemes of putting links in space. For example, now it looks like links arranged in circle, placed on equal distance, we should also be able to use square grid, hexagonal grid, arrangements like on dice and playing cards and so on. So we should be able to use different space filling patterns and strategies for links from 1 to infinity. Circle placement still should be default for 1-4 links. We also should add physical (force) placement like in traditional graphs, but we should modify algorithm so it works nicely with links. We should do careful double checking of all the mechanics and so on, and improve if we see something wrong and so on. Also for some reason copy of image to clipboard does not work in Safari. We need to double check we fully support mobile browsers and desktop ones like Google Chrome, Safari, Firefox. We need to download all logs and data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), in which we will reconstruct timeline/sequence of events, list of each and all requirements from the issue, find root causes of the each problem, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions). If there is not enough data to find actual root cause, add debug output and verbose mode if not present, that will allow us to find root cause on next iteration. If issue related to any other repository/project, where we can report issues on GitHub, please do so. Each issue must contain reproducible examples, workarounds and suggestions for fix the issue in code. Also double check to fully apply requirements to entire codebase, so if we have issue in multiple places, it should be fixed in all them. Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
